notes.title: Let there be NIGHT!
notes.notes:
While you're waiting on a release date for Solaria, did you know I've been recapping the development process over on YouTube? 

The videos are slowly but surely catching up with the real-time state of the game, and are a chance to take a terrifying peek into my mind as well as give your own feedback on the direction the game is taking!

[previewyoutube=vYOZe1QdImY;full][/previewyoutube]

Episode #2 was just released, but you can [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2xtZzGPqRi4dFD03mbue7Pw7_nOvw_qg]find the entire playlist so far right here[/url].

And for those of you who prefer to stay Google-free, [url=https://makertube.net/@teahands]they're all up on PeerTube too[/url]. 

In this episode we're looking back at how Solaria went from an empty static world, to a bustling hive of (temporarily pointless) activity with citizens, a full day night cycle, and the addition of some birds flying overhead just to make things seem a little more alive.

Which of course, all makes it sound very straightforward. 

Naturally it was anything but.
